thesis: Chicago underground trap metal footage, a playable floating song orbit, black-room gallery, and the 0S founder lane live inside one Gray Skyes artist universe.
interactiveSurfaces: index.html renders a universe hub with all kept tracks as floating playable song objects plus routes into separate catalog, video, gallery, release, 0S, live, and dashboard rooms.
catalog.html plays all kept tracks through the public catalog player.
video-rooms.html reads query-string video IDs and switches the full loop room.
music-video.html redirects old video links into video-rooms.html.
dashboard.html writes public song title overrides into localStorage and the catalog reads them.
gallery.html opens actual dropped images in a modal.
release.html frames playable drops as a packaged fan release surface.
live.html presents concert recap, booking contact, and press angles.
scenes/gray-base64-scene.html embeds Gray image data directly into the first-viewport signal scene.
